name: Cerebra Integrated Technologies Limited
about: Cerebra Integrated Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiary, trades in computer systems and peripherals in India. The company provides electronics manufacturing services for motherboards, memory modules, graphic cards, and networking products; enterprise solutions, including IT hardware and software infrastructure design, planning, and implementation; and turnkey networking solutions. It also offers e-waste recycling, refining, and refurbishment; device-as-a-service; and information technology infrastructure management services. The company serves SMEs, NGOs, producers, corporates, banks, manufacturers, resellers, institutions, and individuals. Cerebra Integrated Technologies Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.
